subtopics.title: Prompt Fundamentals
subtopics.summary: Defines what a prompt is, its key components such as system prompt, user prompt, examples, and context, and how prompt engineering guides model behavior without changing weights.

subtopics.title: Prompt Engineering Best Practices
subtopics.summary: Covers techniques for writing effective prompts, including crafting detailed instructions, providing examples, systematic testing, versioning prompts, and standardizing evaluation metrics.

subtopics.title: Prompt Engineering Tools
subtopics.summary: Discusses tools that assist with prompt engineering, such as those for structured outputs and prompt variation, along with risks like hidden API calls and unnecessary costs.

subtopics.title: Prompt Attacks and Defense
subtopics.summary: Covers how to defend AI applications against prompt attacks as part of building production-ready systems.
